arguments.summary: Maple Crossing (10-suite retail, Columbus OH, as of 2026-08-31): the certified 2026-08-31 rent roll controls (the 2026-06-30 archive roll is stale and excluded). Nine of ten suites are in possession (29,070 of 32,150 SF; 0.9000 unit / 0.9042 area occupancy); Suite 010 (Small/Group A) is vacant. All active leases expire 2029-08-31, so there is no near-term rollover. A fully executed amendment (signed 2026-07-20, effective 2026-08-01) raises Suite 001 rent by $350 to $7,000/month, making annual in-place rent $743,100; per instruction the prescribed stabilized gross potential uses pre-amendment all-suite scheduled rent of $818,700. Underwriting: EGI $781,265 (5% economic loss, $350/suite other income); opex $252,675 including 3% management fee; NOI before reserves $528,590; NCF after $300/suite reserves $525,590. Capitalized at 6.7500% the value indication is $7,830,964. Sizing at the greater of note (6.5000%) and floor (6.00%) over 30-year monthly amortization gives LTV limit $5,090,126 (binding), DSCR limit $5,543,602, debt yield limit $5,839,889 — maximum loan $5,090,126, DSCR 1.36x, debt yield 10.33%. After 1% origination ($50,901), $45,000 closing costs and $4,300,000 payoff, net cash-out is +$694,225 (no shortfall). Deliverables created: artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx (live formulas, sensitivity table, source register) and artifacts/memorandum-v1.pdf (6 pages). Photos, asking price, comps, appraisal and sponsor history are not supplied and remain explicitly unknown.
qualifications: Two rent rolls conflict; resolved by date — the 2026-08-31 certified roll controls and the 2026-06-30 archive roll (rents $75 lower per suite) is excluded. This is a resolved conflict, not an open item.

Underwritten gross potential is a prescribed stabilized assumption ($818,700 = all-suite pre-amendment scheduled rent x 12) and intentionally differs from annual in-place rent of $743,100; the Suite 001 amendment affects in-place rent only.
Reported T12 NOI ($507,593) is a cash figure excluding any management fee and reserves; it is not comparable line-for-line to underwritten NOI or NCF.
Insurance $28,655 is annual expense; $2,000,000 is the general liability aggregate policy limit — different measures.
Loan is sized on a fully amortizing 30-year payment at 6.5000% even though the first 24 months are interest-only, per instruction; actual IO-period coverage would be higher.
Manager headline of 9-of-10 leased counts occupied plus pending; the certified roll contains no pending-possession suite, so the methodology risk is disclosed but has no numeric effect here.
Capitalized value is an income-approach indication only; no appraisal, asking price, or market sales/rent comparables are in the packet.
Legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews are incomplete — routine pending diligence, with no defect findings asserted.
Not supplied and explicitly unknown (not zero): photographs, asking price, market comps, sponsor history, tenant credit, monthly T12 detail, TI/LC and capital budgets.
